sources.publisher: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Applied Aerodynamics Group
observed_facts: The database describes wind-tunnel measurements for small-UAV and model-aircraft propellers
The landing page identifies four volumes
The landing page states that its static-performance Reynolds number uses the 75-percent blade station chord and rotational speed
The landing page cites separate UIUC and Ohio State load-cell measurement approaches
unknowns: Exact data-file bytes and per-file SHA-256
Current reuse and redistribution terms for each volume and geometry file
Test-by-test measurement uncertainty and calibration metadata
Coverage applicability to Wren 2 or Wayfarer 4 installed configurations

sources.publisher: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Applied Aerodynamics Group
observed_facts: The page lists nearly 140 propellers used in small UAV/model-aircraft applications
Measurements include thrust and torque coefficients over advance ratio at specified RPMs
Static performance is provided over RPM sweeps
Approximate digitized propeller geometry is linked for some propellers
The page notes that current online records include an updated wind-tunnel fixture-drag correction and should be preferred over older thesis figures/tables
The four-digit run labels in the data index identify RPM values
unknowns: Exact selected geometry and data files
File schema, delimiters, units and precision for each chosen run
Per-channel uncertainty, tare/correction lineage and calibration record
Applicability to an installed propeller/wing interaction

sources.publisher: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Applied Aerodynamics Group
observed_facts: The page lists nearly 70 small-scale propellers
Thirty-five were purchased off-the-shelf and balanced; remaining entries include variants of four 3-D-printed propeller families
Measurements include thrust and torque coefficients over advance ratio at specified RPMs and static RPM sweeps
The page states coefficients are based on true measured propeller diameter, which may differ from the nominal listed size
Power coefficient is derived from measured torque and rotational speed
unknowns: Exact selected geometry and data-file bytes
Per-run calibration and uncertainty
Applicability to installed propeller/wing interference

sources.publisher: International Journal of Micro Air Vehicles / SAGE
observed_facts: Publisher abstract reports a low-speed wind-tunnel MAV experiment
Freestream velocity was 9 m/s
Reynolds number was 135000 based on root chord
Propeller speed was varied from 8000 to 10000 rpm
The study compared attached motor/propeller installation with a decoupled arrangement intended to separate propeller thrust from aircraft-model forces
Publisher abstract reports increased lift coefficient at higher angle of attack and increased drag coefficient under propeller-induced flow, with stronger effects at higher RPM
unknowns: Full article file and exact byte digest
Exact wing and propeller geometry and installation dimensions
Full operating-point matrix and angle-of-attack values
Raw/processed lift, drag and propeller thrust data availability
Force-balance calibration, fixture correction, repeatability and uncertainty
Whether underlying datasets are publicly reusable

sources.publisher: NASA Langley Research Center; NASA Technical Reports Server
observed_facts: Paper describes a full-scale X-57 high-lift propeller component test in NASA Langley Low Speed Aeroacoustic Wind Tunnel
X-57 high-lift configuration uses 12 fixed-pitch propellers upstream of the wing leading edge
Freestream test matrix includes 0, 35, 58, 75 and 90 KEAS
The test includes multiple RPM and power/torque operating points
The report describes 439 time-averaged data points over more than 15 hours of powered operation
The report says thrust-direction force measurements experienced cross-loading and thermal drift
The report states shaft torque measurements were substantially more reliable than thrust during these tests
The report describes high-speed imagery, propeller deployment/stowing and windmilling observations
unknowns: Exact PDF bytes and SHA-256
Raw test-data file availability and terms
Calibration and cross-axis correction matrices for the ATI load cell
Full per-run thrust uncertainty values and time-series records
Exact propeller geometry, handedness-specific material/production batch and installation fixture files
No integrated wing/propeller lift distribution is established by this component-stand paper alone

sources.publisher: NASA; technical paper listed in X-57 technical papers index
sources.paper_title: Exploring the Effects of Installation Geometry in High-Lift Propeller Systems
observed_facts: NASA index describes a wind-tunnel experiment varying high-lift propeller height, offset and inclination
NASA index reports propeller height as the most critical variable in the study
The index says height for maximum lift depends on angle of attack and flap deflection
The index describes a relationship between optimal propeller height and unblown wing lift coefficient
unknowns: Canonical full-paper URL and exact bytes
Exact geometry, operating conditions and numerical test matrix
Measured force/moment/pressure data and uncertainty
Propeller geometry, sensor placement and test-facility corrections

global_claim_constraints: UIUC maps are isolated component evidence, not installed wing interaction validation
X57 component stand data do not establish X57 installed wing force distribution
Thrust and torque uncertainty must remain channel-specific
Unacquired bytes and unreviewed terms cannot be admitted as reference truth
No CRM transonic or X57 reference result directly validates Wren 2 or Wayfarer 4
Candidate-specific performance requires source-bound geometry, mass/loading state, atmosphere, installed propulsion and relevant physical validation
X-57 component stand results are not direct validation of installed wing force distribution
